fusions.name: Rote Tripline
fusions.desc: Throws a prepared snare that deals 8 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Sprung by the Book
fusions.desc: Springs every snare set around you in a burst that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Thrice-Set Jaws
fusions.desc: Sets jaws at the nearest enemy that arm after 0.5 seconds and wait up to 20 seconds. The trap deals 12 damage to each of the first 3 enemies to come within 2 tiles, resetting itself after each.

fusions.name: Follow-Up Drill
fusions.desc: When you put a condition on an enemy, your next 2 abilities deal 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
